$comment: Tier-2 read-back differential for the wardrobe ITEM + FOLDER MUTATIONS
(v4 lib/wardrobe/item-mutations.ts + create-body.ts + folder-mutations.ts,
4a38222e6; P4.D279 keystone C1 §11), ported to
quilltap-core::services::wardrobe_item_mutations + ::wardrobe_folder_mutations.
One committed file drives BOTH sides:
- build-item-mutations-fixture.ts bakes a character + vault via the REAL
repos.characters.create, provisions Quilltap General (doc_mount_points row
+ instance_settings.generalMountPointId), then seeds FOUR items through
v4's REAL createItem(location, body, { preserve }) — two in General (a
`top` and a `footwear`, components for a composite), two in the character's
vault (a leaf `top`, a leaf `accessories`) — every id and stamp pinned.
- item-mutations-tier2.ts (the oracle) and item_mutations_tier2_equivalence.rs
(the port) each copy the fixture and run `ops` through the REAL / ported
createItem / updateItem / setItemArchived / moveItemsToFolder /
componentLookupFor / validateComponentRefs and createWardrobeFolder /
renameWardrobeFolder / deleteWardrobeFolder over resolveWardrobeLocation.
RECORD per op: { op, result | error, items: location.readItems(true),
folders: location.listFolders(), logs: the [ItemMutations] / [FolderMutations]
DEBUG lines (message + fields, values stringified) }.
NORMALISATION (the Rust test, both sides): a create without `preserve` mints
a uuid — at most ONE new id appears per op, remapped to <minted:N> in op order
wherever it occurs (items, componentItemIds, results, log fields); every ISO
timestamp that is not a pinned stamp -> <ts>. Everything else exact —
`fields` (v4's Object.keys(next) order) included, so each patch below lists
its keys in the port's fixed order (title, types, componentItemIds,
description, imagePrompt, appropriateness, isDefault, replace, folder).
OPS: the 26 cases of item-mutations.test.ts and the folder-mutations surface,
on a real store: leaf create at the root; create into Formal/Evening (new
folder rows); a composite with a lookup (types widen over General + own
components); a composite WITHOUT a lookup (designated kept); a preserved
create (id/stamps/archivedAt/provenance kept); an update touching neither
components nor types; a component change that WIDENS (footwear kept though
no component covers it — bug 195); restated narrower types still widened over
the components; a leaf's restated types kept as given; a same-folder update
(case-blind) that moves nothing; a folder change; archived twice (the second
keeps the stamp — bug 188) and a restore; setItemArchived's idempotence; a
move of two own ids (deduped) into a new folder; a move naming a BORROWED
General id (refused whole, nothing written); General's own-folder-only lookup
and a General composite (the own-vault ref is missing); createWardrobeFolder
('Hats', 'hats' -> Hats, '' -> error, 'images' -> error); rename (Hats ->
Caps, onto an existing sibling -> 409, a missing folder -> 404); deleteFolder
(Casual re-roots the gown; Formal sends Evening up; Outerwear holding a
planted note -> 409 strays, nothing moved; Evening empty).
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key (the same one the other
wardrobe families use). NOT the real Friday pepper; safe to commit.
